Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You catch the loosening bandage and press down firmly before another pulse of blood escapes.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing creature, before its Bleeding damage at turn end.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a free hand and cloth; grants no item.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Recovery

Reduce temporary Bleeding by 1, minimum 0, then resolve remaining Bleeding and its normal decay. This does not remove a starred contribution, heal a wound or restore HP.
